##############################################################################
# CMake build for STM32F407IGH6 (C型开发板) - "light_on"
#
# HAL / CMSIS project generated by STM32CubeMX.
# Toolchain: GNU Arm Embedded (arm-none-eabi-gcc) + Ninja
#
# Build:  cmake --preset debug && cmake --build --preset debug
# Output: build/Debug/light_on.elf (.hex / .bin)
##############################################################################
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

project(light_on C ASM)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Target MCU: STM32F407IGH6  (Cortex-M4F, 1MB Flash, 128KB RAM + 64KB CCM)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(MCU_FLAGS -mcpu=cortex-m4 -mthumb -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard)

add_compile_definitions(USE_HAL_DRIVER STM32F407xx)

add_compile_options(
    ${MCU_FLAGS}
    -Wall
    -fdata-sections
    -ffunction-sections
)

add_compile_options(
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-Og>
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-g3>
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-gdwarf-4>
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Os>
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-g0>
)

include_directories(
    Core/Inc
    Drivers/STM32F4xx_HAL_Driver/Inc
    Drivers/STM32F4xx_HAL_Driver/Inc/Legacy
    Drivers/CMSIS/Device/ST/STM32F4xx/Include
    Drivers/CMSIS/Include
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sources
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 自动包含 Core/Src 下所有 .c（CubeMX 以后新增 gpio.c / tim.c 等也能编到）
file(GLOB_RECURSE CORE_SOURCES Core/Src/*.c)

file(GLOB_RECURSE HAL_DRIVER_SOURCES Drivers/STM32F4xx_HAL_Driver/Src/*.c)
# HAL ships some files as templates - they must NOT be compiled (the real
# implementations live in Core/Src or are copied by the user on purpose).
list(FILTER HAL_DRIVER_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX ".*_template\\.c$")

set(STARTUP_SOURCE
    Drivers/CMSIS/Device/ST/STM32F4xx/Source/Templates/gcc/startup_stm32f407xx.s
)

set(LINKER_SCRIPT ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/STM32F407IGHX_FLASH.ld)

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME}.elf
    ${CORE_SOURCES}
    ${HAL_DRIVER_SOURCES}
    ${STARTUP_SOURCE}
)

target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME}.elf PRIVATE
    ${MCU_FLAGS}
    -T${LINKER_SCRIPT}
    --specs=nano.specs
    --specs=nosys.specs
    -Wl,--gc-sections
    -Wl,-Map=${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}.map
    -Wl,--print-memory-usage
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Post build: generate .hex / .bin and show size
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_custom_command(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME}.elf POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O ihex   $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}.elf> ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}.hex
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}.elf> ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/${PROJECT_NAME}.bin
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_SIZE} $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}.elf>
    COMMENT "Generating light_on.hex / light_on.bin"
)
